business_summary.text: Powerica makes Cummins-powered diesel generator sets and medium-speed large generators with Hyundai, and runs an independent wind power business plus BoP EPC and O&M.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at double-digit, reiterated from earlier.
DG set margins to remain subdued in Q1 and part of Q2, improving from Q3 onward.
50 MW wind project to be commissioned in Q4FY27; 150 MW in FY28 and 100 MW the year after.
New wind projects expected at 82-83% EBITDA margin; old 330 MW at 62-63%; EPC at 10-11%.
Commodity price inflation and geopolitical uncertainty weighed on margins; price hikes taken in two phases.
Tax rate guided at 25.168% for the year, normalising after last year's one-time deferred tax reversal.
MSLG won a ₹41 Cr tender to be executed over 12-15 months; pipeline strong with PSU second phase.
Management is targeting double-digit top line growth in FY27.
The company repaid ₹525 Cr of existing debt in Q1 FY27 using IPO proceeds.
Data centers contributed 12% of total revenue in FY26 with robust ongoing order visibility.
9MFY26 EBITDA margin 13.6% and PAT margin 10.5%; Q3 margin 10.4%.
DG sets were 81.8% and wind 18.2% of 9MFY26 revenue; mix drives overall margin.
BoP EPC: 450.40 MW developed, 435.60 MW under construction, LOA for 150 MW.

operating_notes.text: Generator Set segment EBITDA margin was 9.3% in 9MFY26 vs 8.6% in 9MFY25; Wind Power segment margin was 33.1% vs 42.7%.
DG sets powered by Cummins engines contributed 63.7% of 9MFY26 revenue (70.0% a year earlier); MSLG with Hyundai 5.5% (2.0%).
Operational wind portfolio of 12 projects under 25-year fixed-tariff PPAs with GUVNL and SECI; EPC for BoP covers 12 projects totalling 450.40 MW.
9MFY26 DG set segment EBITDA margin 9.3% vs 8.6% a year earlier; wind segment margin 33.1% vs 42.7%.
Wind IPP: 330.85 MW operating under 25-year PPAs, tariff range ₹2.4–4.19/kWh; 50 MW under construction at ₹3.81/kWh.
BoP EPC: 450.40 MW developed, 435.60 MW under construction, LOA for 150 MW; also a 7.2 km 400 kV line and 220/400 kV substation.
FY26 segment EBITDA margins: Generator Set 9.1% (FY25 8.4%), Wind Power 31.3% (FY25 41.4%).
FY26 revenue mix: Cummins-powered DG sets 65.5%, MSLG with Hyundai 5.1%, allied business 12.5%, wind IPP 6.7%, BoP EPC and O&M 10.1%.
O&M services for BoP at 10 wind projects totalling 296.50 MW; EPC for BoP covers 12 projects totalling 450.40 MW.
Data centers contributed 12% of total revenue in FY26.
Company repaid ₹525 Cr of borrowings in Q1FY27 post-IPO.
DG set capacity utilisation was 75-80% in Q1FY27 on a single shift.
Data centre order book was ₹900 Cr as of 31 July 2026 and ₹1,100 Cr as of 7 August 2026, with a single order over ₹200 Cr.
Wind IPP portfolio stands at 330.85 MW operating, with 250 MW of new wins taking visibility to 638.35 MW; new projects expected at 82-83% EBITDA margin vs 62-63% for old projects.

GUVNL LoI dated October 19, 2026 covers a 50 MW wind project in Gujarat at ₹3.51/kWh for 25 years, with the PPA due within 15 business days of GERC tariff adoption and commissioning within 24 months of the PPA.
